messages:
Priya (eng-oncall): wrapping up my shift — quick handoff below, sorry for the long one.

Priya (eng-oncall): CURRENT: embed service saw a spike in KV-cache miss errors starting ~02:58 UTC (INC-2026). Errors were ~8% of requests for a ~10min window, upstream model latency elevated ~200ms.

Priya (eng-oncall): MITIGATIONS APPLIED: scaled embed-workers +2 in us-west-2, enabled prefix-KV fallback for the hot prefix (temp), bumped per-customer rate-limit for background batchers by 20% to reduce retries.

Priya (eng-oncall): EVIDENCE / COMMANDS I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embed-workers | tail -n 120 | grep "kv_cache_miss"
# sample: 2026-03-14T02:59:03Z kv_cache_miss key=usr:1234 prefix=search qps=120
```

Priya (eng-oncall): NOTES: the recent quantized model rollout for embed-xq-v2 (deployed 03:12) increased mem pressure on a subset of pods; autoscaler didn't trigger fast enough due to conservative CPU metrics. Not rolling back yet — we kept the model but used fallback to older embed-xq-v1 for new requests while we stabilize.

Sam (eng-oncall): ack, saw alerts. I'll keep an eye on the dashboards and watch the error rate. Can you paste the Grafana panel link?

Priya (eng-oncall): https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/embeds/embed-ops?orgId=1&from=now-30m&to=now — panel 'embed_kv_miss_percent' is the one I was watching.

Jordi (infra): I'll reprovision two extra worker nodes in us-west-2 now. ETA ~20m. Do we want them as g5-standard or g5-highmem?

Priya (eng-oncall): g5-highmem for the hot-prefix pods, please. Also cordon the older nodes after workloads drain.

Marta (sre): I updated the alert thresholds and added a temporary suppression window for noisier customers: alert name `embed_kv_fallback_rate`. New threshold: 5% sustained over 5m -> page. Old: 3% over 3m. I documented the change in the runbook. PR: https://git.redwood/r/runbooks/pulls/88

Marta (sre): Added postmortem checklist entry to ensure autoscaler uses both CPU and RSS mem for this ASG (low-priority follow-up).

Priya (eng-oncall): DEPLOY NOTE: deploy-bot ran a config update at 03:12 but that was the model tagging change, not the runtime config.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: service=embed-workers, image=embed-xq-v2:2026-03-14-0312, rollout=canary(20%) -> success checks pass.

Sam (eng-oncall): quick asks before I take over:
- I'll keep the fallback in place for 30m and then try traffic-shift to v2 at 10%.
- Can someone approve PR #3418 (batching heuristics) — it's got perf fixes that reduce mem spikes.

Jordi (infra): reprovision started — creating 2 x g5-highmem nodes in us-west-2. I set `maxUnavail=1` to avoid service disruption.

Marta (sre): I'm going to add a short-lived Grafana panel alert that watches pod RSS/mem and will auto-scale the ASG if avg_rss > 78% for 4m. Putting a quick incident note in the ops doc.

Priya (eng-oncall): NEXT STEPS / HANDOFF:
- Sam: monitor `embed_kv_miss_percent`, keep fallback for 30m, traffic-shift to v2 at 10% if errors <1% for 10m.
- Jordi: confirm when new nodes are live and annotate infra ticket #INF-672.
- Marta: verify alert changes and add rollback runbook step.

Priya (eng-oncall): BLOCKERS: none open for me. I'll be reachable for 10m for any questions, then off. Thanks all :coffee: :thumbsup:

Sam (eng-oncall): taking over. Ping me on thread if anything. Approving PR #3418 now.

Jordi (infra): nodes are up, pods draining onto new nodes now. Marked INF-672 as in-progress.

Marta (sre): alert change live, runbook updated: https://git.redwood/r/runbooks/ops/embed-incident.md#inc-2026. Setting a reminder to review autoscaler config tomorrow.

Sam (eng-oncall): quick FYI — I'll also mute customer-specific noisy alerts for cust-phi-9 for 1h.

Priya (eng-oncall): awesome, thanks team. Leaving handoff to Sam. Good night!
